name: Dreams of Bloom
description: Something seems to be troubling Sakuya the florist...

dialogs.content: Hello there! How would you like to grow some flowers of your very own?
What sort of flowers?
Oh, interested, are we? Don't worry about not understanding everything at first, let me explain it to you in brief.
My name is Sakuya, and I'm a gardener who also runs a little business regarding flowers on the side.
Well, I call it a business, but really, I just send people flowers most of the time, or I help some store with ikebana...
What's ikebana?
Oh, you're not familiar? Ikebana is a very important art in Inazuma.
In simple terms, you can consider ikebana the act of carefully cutting and processing flowers and other plants before arranging them in a suitable fashion...
In specific, however, you need to take care to grasp the current state of the plants and trim the less presentable parts of them away...
Moreover, your arrangement and placement must be suited to their environment, even down to the angle at which the flowers extend outward...
These details must be given fastidious consideration, and can be a cumbersome process indeed.
Even for someone who loves ikebana like me, it is a most tiring job...
I used to have a storefront in the city, but the streets were far too noisy for me to concentrate on my work.
So I closed the shop, and now I just receive customers next to my flower field.
It's a quieter spot for sure, though I do get less business...
Which is why I've specially devised a promotion plan to advertise my shop, "Sakuya's Flowers."
I call this plan... "Dreams of Bloom"!
And what does this plan entail, exactly?
Specifically, it is about allowing customers to grow their own flowers and then create their own unique flower arrangements.
If you're interested in giving it a try, just let me know. Growing and arranging flowers are both very interesting indeed, you know?
